name: Nazara Technologies

snapshot.about: Global gaming operating platform across mobile, PC, console, offline gaming, adtech, and sports media businesses.

narrative: Management achieved its FY26 core gaming growth and margin targets, delivering 107% gaming revenue growth against a 20-25% target and 24.7% margin against a 20-25% goal. However, net profit stagnated at ₹35 crore in Q2 FY27 despite revenue growing 52.7% to ₹803 crore.

promises.statement: Company targets core gaming revenue growth of 20-25% year-on-year.

said.quote: We are targeting to grow our core gaming business at 20-25% year-on-year

actual_source.quote: FY '26 revenue growing 107% year-on-year to INR 1,072 crores and EBITDA growing 157% to INR 265 crores

promises.note: Core gaming business revenue grew 107% in FY26, comfortably exceeding the 20-25% target.

promises.statement: Company aims for 20-25% EBITDA margin range in core gaming business.

said.quote: We're also aiming for an EBITDA margin in the 20-25% range for the core gaming business

actual_source.quote: resulting in an EBITDA margin of 24.7%

promises.note: Core gaming business achieved a 24.7% EBITDA margin in FY26, meeting the target range.

promises.statement: Offline gaming EBITDA margin expected to land between 25% to 35% on a steady state.

said.quote: I think on a steady state, what I said earlier, between 25% to 35% is where we should land up at

actual_source.quote: Our offline gaming businesses with Smaaash and Funky Monkeys also delivered profitability during FY '26, with revenues of INR 99 crores and EBITDA of INR 27 crores

promises.note: Offline gaming achieved an EBITDA margin of 27.3% in FY26 and 33% in Q1 FY27.

promises.statement: NODWIN is looking to raise between $100 million to $200 million independently.

said.quote: NODWIN is looking both to raise funds between $100 million to $200 million independently which should be a mixture of primary and secondary, and then also prepare for an IPO as soon as possible

promises.statement: Curve Games' target margin is always 50% on any signed game.

said.quote: Yes, our margin target is always 50% on any game that we sign

promises.statement: Overall capital commitment across SMAAASH and Funky Monkeys is approximately INR 50 crores.

said.quote: Right now, our overall commitment across these two businesses, including some stake increase in Funky Monkeys, is approximately INR 50 odd crore

promises.statement: Margins should rise beyond 20% in the coming year.

said.quote: Eventually, the margin should rise to beyond 20% is what we are working towards

promises.note: Targeting margins above 20% remains in progress.

promises.statement: Curve Games expects to launch at least 6 new game releases in FY27.

said.quote: We expect to launch at least 6 new releases in this current year, maybe a couple more

promises.statement: NODWIN is targeting organic growth of at least 30% in FY27.

said.quote: NODWIN is targeting organic growth of 30%+ for FY27 and is progressing towards its IPO readiness

promises.statement: Management believes Funky Monkeys can expand from 14 to 100 centers in next couple of years.

said.quote: We believe the current 14 centers can get to 100 centers in the next couple of years

signals.quote: Over FY22–FY26, operating cash flow of ₹376 crore covered all of reported profit, ₹320 crore.
signals.source: Computed from screener.in's cash-flow statement and ratios

cash.read: Profits turn into cash reliably, with cumulative operating cash flows of ₹376 crore exceeding reported net profits of ₹320 crore over FY22–FY26.

bull.point: Gaming segment delivered strong growth with full-year FY26 revenue surging 107% year-on-year to ₹1,072 crores at a 24.7% EBITDA margin.

evidence.quote: FY '26 revenue growing 107% year-on-year to INR 1,072 crores and EBITDA growing 157% to INR 265 crores
resulting in an EBITDA margin of 24.7%

bull.point: Operating cash flows fully back accounting profits, generating ₹376 crore in cash flow against ₹320 crore in net profit over FY22–FY26.

evidence.quote: Over FY22–FY26, operating cash flow of ₹376 crore covered all of reported profit, ₹320 crore.
evidence.source: Computed from screener.in's cash-flow statement and ratios

bull.point: Pre-tax operating cash flow expanded 81% year-on-year in FY26 to reach ₹213 crores.

evidence.quote: pre-tax operating cash flows growing 81% year-on-year to INR 213 crores

bear.point: The auditor highlighted an emphasis of matter regarding significant impairment losses on an associate due to real money gaming regulation.

evidence.quote: describes the recognition of impairment loss of ` 98,894 Lakhs on investment in one of the associate company due to prohibition in offering of online money games

bear.point: The company suffered a net loss of ₹82 crores in Q1 FY27 driven by associate losses and impairment charges.

evidence.quote: We reported a PAT loss of INR 82 crores, largely attributable to the share of loss from associates and impairment loss
